option_relations.rationale: Option A describes a hepatic abscess caused by Staphylococcus, which is equivalent to 'Liver Abscess due to Staphylococcus aureus'.
Option B explicitly states 'Liver Abscess (Staphylococcus aureus)', which is equivalent to 'Liver Abscess due to Staphylococcus aureus'.

Option C describes Severe congenital neutropenia (SCN) with hepatic abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus. While the hepatic abscess caused by S. aureus is a component of this option, SCN is a broader condition that predisposes to such infections, making the option a supertype of the specific liver abscess.

Option D, 'Immunodeficiency Disorder (ELANE mutation-associated)', describes an underlying condition (immunodeficiency due to ELANE mutation) that can predispose to infections like a liver abscess caused by Staphylococcus aureus. Therefore, it is an etiology of the leaf disease.
